rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's page, dated 24 May 2014, carries the 'Address by His Excellency President Jacob Zuma on the occasion of his Inauguration as fifth President of the Republic of South Africa Union Buildings, Pretoria'. He says he stands 'to accept the mandate bestowed upon us by millions of our people, to lead this great nation for the next five years', twenty years after Mandela 'took the oath of office at this very Amphitheatre'.
